notes: The general excise tax applies to food (an income tax credit offsets it for lower-income residents); county surcharges of up to 0.5% apply.
GET applies to the sales price of fuel excluding federal and state fuel taxes.
The general excise tax is levied on businesses and is usually passed on to buyers; county surcharge up to 0.5%. It applies to services, including personal care and repair labor.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Hawaii levies a general excise tax on sellers rather than a sales tax: 4% state plus a 0.5% county surcharge in every county except Kalawao. It applies to nearly all sales, including groceries and services. Sellers may pass it on at up to 4.712%; the statutory 4.5% is used here.
